info.name: NL-to-SQL App
info.description: Collection to test the Natural Language to SQL app's API independently from the UI. Uses the {{base_url}} variable (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000, configurable in the collection's variables).

request.description: Health check: confirms the service is up and the database loaded correctly. Expected response (200): {"status": "ok", "database_connected": true}
Tests the data layer in isolation, without going through the model. Useful to confirm the database and schema are fine before suspecting the model. Expected response (200): columns + rows.

This endpoint doesn't pre-validate the SQL (see Phase 4 of the build doc) — any SQLite error is returned as-is with status 400. Expected response (400): {"detail": "...no such table: table_that_does_not_exist..."}
Success case already tested manually in Phase 4, steps 5/6. Expected response (200): sql with 'ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 3', columns ['title','price'], 3 rows, attempts: 1.
Success case already tested manually in Phase 4, steps 5/6. Expected response (200): sql with 'ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3', columns ['title','price'], 3 rows, attempts: 1.

Direct request, no previous steps needed. FastAPI/Pydantic rejects the body before it reaches the handler because the 'question' field is missing. Expected response (422): detail as a LIST of objects (Pydantic's own format), different from the TextToSQLError 422 (which is a string) — see how app.js tells both apart in describeAskError, Phase 4 step 7.

⚠️ Does not trigger just by sending this request. To reproduce it: restart uvicorn with ASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1 (e.g. `ASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1 uvicorn app.main:app --reload`) and only then send this same request. Expected response (504): {"detail": "The request took too long to process (over 1s). Try rephrasing your question."}. Restart uvicorn without that variable (or with the normal value) afterwards.

item.name: POST /ask - could not connect (requires manual setup)

request.description: ⚠️ Does not trigger just by sending this request. To reproduce it: stop the Ollama terminal (Ctrl+C) and only then send this same request — with uvicorn up but Ollama down. MAX_RETRIES attempts get exhausted and it responds 422 (not 503; this is already noted as pending in Phase 6 of the build doc, Ollama section). Restart Ollama afterwards.
